metadata.case_name: ALTAF AHMED v. INNOVATIVE NETWORK ENGINEERING CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: security guard (guard at a commercial building in Central)

injuries.description: back injury resulting in pain and prolapsed intervertebral discs at L3/L4 and L4/L5 levels, with a loss of earning capacity of 5%.
source: the plaintiff had sustained a back injury resulting in pain and prolapsed intervertebral discs at L3/L4 and L4/L5 levels, with a loss of earning capacity of 5%.
injuries.icd_description: Certain specified injuries of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: three levels of lumbar disc prolapse, which was indicative of degenerative changes; aggravation of a pre-existing lesion or an injury superimposed upon a pre-existing condition.
source: there were three levels of lumbar disc prolapse, which was indicative of degenerative changes

the several levels of lumbar disc protrusion were degenerative disc prolapses, and that one of the degenerative discs present before the injury was aggravated by the injury, giving rise to the symptoms and signs of a single lower lumbar disc prolapse.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: persistent pain (repeated attendances for "persistent pain" at A&E)
loss of earning capacity of 5% (as identified by the EC (Ordinary Assessment) Board)

treatments_received: attendance at Accident and Emergency Department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital; treated and discharged with analgesic
re-attendances at A&E on multiple dates for persistent pain

losses.description: Pain and suffering and loss of amenity (PSLA)
Reduced earning capacity and requirement to move to lighter work (acceleration of move to lighter work by approximately 10-15 years); permanent impairment estimated at 5-7%
